description: Turn a raise percentage into your new salary, plus the monthly and annual increase.

faqs.a: New salary = current salary × (1 + raise% ÷ 100). Annual increase = new − current; monthly increase = annual increase ÷ 12.
faqs.q: How is the new salary calculated?

faqs.a: Yes — enter the total as one percentage (e.g. 7% for a 4% merit raise plus 3% promotion bump).
faqs.q: Can I combine merit and promotion raises?

faqs.a: No — this is gross pay before taxes. Your take-home increase will be smaller after taxes and deductions.

howto: Read your new salary and the monthly/annual increase.
